subject: reasoning
question: L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre(but not necessarily in the same order) . O is sitting to the immediate left of M and the immediate right of Q. L is sitting to the immediate left of Q and the immediate right of P. R is sitting to the immediate right of M and the immediate left of N. Who is sitting to the immediate right of N?
solution:
L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre(but not necessarily in the same order) .

 
• O is sitting to the immediate left of M and the immediate right of Q.
 
• L is sitting to the immediate left of Q and the immediate right of P.
 
• R is sitting to the immediate right of M and the immediate left of N

The Final Arrrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cdf68c8424572c43cd159fab20ebaa7e3925308c846fb2cc85cfb2839970fd4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
